entries.title: Proverbs 16:1
segments: The plans of the heart belong to man; But the answer of the tongue is from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:2
segments: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the spirits.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:3
segments: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:4
segments: Jehovah hath made everything for its own end; Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:5
segments: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Jehovah: [Though] hand [join] in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:6
segments: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for; And by the fear of Jehovah men depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:7
segments: When a man's ways please Jehovah, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:8
segments: Better is a little, with righteousness, Than great revenues with injustice.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:9
segments: A man's heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:10
segments: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth shall not transgress in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:11
segments: A just balance and scales are Jehovah's; All the weights of the bag are his work.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:12
segments: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:13
segments: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:14
segments: The wrath of a king is [as] messengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:15
segments: In the light of the king's countenance is life; And his favor is as a cloud of the latter rain.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:16
segments: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:17
segments: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:18
segments: Pride [goeth] before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:19
segments: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:20
segments: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in Jehovah, happy is he.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:21
segments: The wise in heart shall be called prudent; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:22
segments: Understanding is a well-spring of life unto him that hath it; But the correction of fools is [their] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:23
segments: The heart of the wise instructeth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:24
segments: Pleasant words are [as] a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:25
segments: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:26
segments: The appetite of the laboring man laboreth for him; For his mouth urgeth him [thereto].

entries.title: Proverbs 16:27
segments: A worthless man deviseth mischief; And in his lips there is as a scorching fire.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:28
segments: A perverse man scattereth abroad strife; And a whisperer separateth chief friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:29
segments: A man of violence enticeth his neighbor, And leadeth him in a way that is not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:30
segments: He that shutteth his eyes, [it is] to devise perverse things: He that compresseth his lips bringeth evil to pass.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:31
segments: The hoary head is a crown of glory; It shall be found in the way of righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:32
segments: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit, than he that taketh a city.

entries.title: Proverbs 16:33
segments: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah.
